JORA Corpus 1 (jinofy-corp/jora_corpus1)
	

JORA Corpus 1 is the cleaned and deduplicated pre-training corpus built by JINOVAE Labs, the AI division of JINOVAE (Africa), through its JINOFY data pipeline, to train the JoraMind family of language models. It brings together web text, encyclopedic text, code, mathematics, medicine and agriculture in 18 languages, with a deliberate focus on African languages (Amharic, Hausa, Swahili, Somali, Yoruba, Malagasy, Lingala, Comorian)… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/jinofy-corp/jora_corpus1.
